title: Keep a fixed value
summary: Kotlin: Keep a fixed value. Start with 6 pencils.
introduction: val gives a name to a value that cannot be reassigned. Read the example, then check the result.
learningObjectives: Keep a fixed value with Kotlin

blocks.text: Install a JDK and Kotlin. Save lesson.kt, run kotlinc lesson.kt -include-runtime -d lesson.jar, then java -jar lesson.jar.
val binds pencils to 3. Adding 2 creates the printed result 5.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Use var only if the binding must change.
